tool.name: ffmpeg
tool.versionLine: ffmpeg version 7.1.1 Copyright (c) 2000-2025 the FFmpeg developers
tool.realization: local Homebrew build (--enable-gpl --enable-version3 --enable-libx264 per -buildconf); native libavcodec h264 decoder. Not the nominated FFmpeg 9.0.1 LGPL-only recipe. Output authority: Draft.

preprocessing: h264 yuv420p 320x180 decoded by libavcodec and converted to bgr24 by libswscale with the matrix and ranges declared in the arguments (BT.601, limited range in, full range out; the source is untagged); no scaling, no crop, no rotation, no frame duplication or dropping (passthrough); every indexed packet yields exactly one frame
note: Decoded frame bytes (124 MB) are not committed. Decoder output identity is a property of this exact libavcodec build; a different build may decode to different bytes, in which case the live court reports drift rather than failing.
